description: Read a repository-relative file. Returns its contents, truncated to max_bytes. Credential files are refused by the host, not by you.

max_bytes.description: Truncate after this many bytes. Unbounded reads are a budget violation (L15.4).

path.description: Repository-relative path. Absolute paths, `..` traversal, and the credential denylist (`.env`, `~/.ssh`, keychains) are rejected by the orchestrator, not by the model.

name: read_file

description: List the entries of a repository-relative directory.

recursive.description: Walk subdirectories. Depth and entry count are budgeted regardless (L15.4).

name: list_dir

description: Search the repository for a pattern and return matching lines with their locations.
name: search_text

description: Write a file in the shadow worktree. This never touches the user's working tree; the change is staged for review and is undoable in one keystroke.

path.description: Repository-relative path **inside the shadow worktree**. The user's checkout is not reachable from this tool by construction (L19).

name: write_file

description: Run a build, test, or script inside the sandbox, with the shadow worktree as the working directory. Output is streamed and capped.

argv.description: Argv, already split. A single shell string would invite quoting bugs and make the allowlist unanalysable.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget in seconds. Every command is bounded (L15.4).

name: run_command

description: Run a differential behavioural proof of the current shadow worktree against the baseline and return the verdict with its evidence. The verdict is computed by the engine; you may explain it, never author it.

input_schema.description: Arguments for `prove` — the tool that makes this an agent nobody else can build.

base.description: Baseline revision. Defaults to the task's pre-edit baseline when omitted.

max_inputs.description: Per-target input budget. The verdict always states what was and was not exercised (L2).

symbols.description: Restrict proving to these fully-qualified symbols; omit to prove the changed set.

input_schema.title: ProveArgs

name: prove
